## Summary of Word Types

The list is composed almost entirely of common nouns drawn from a handful of thematic categories. Many words describe natural landscape features, such as canyon, meadow, river, harbor, garden, and stone. A number of terms refer to colors, materials, or substances, including copper, violet, quartz, ember, and amber. Several words denote textiles or fabric-related terms, most notably velvet. A set of words represents objects or tools, such as lantern, signal, anchor, needle, and ledger. Finally, some words capture natural phenomena or seasonal concepts, including thunder, winter, and orbit.
